requirements.quote: Share a brief or handover as a secure, expiring link: the recipient views it and is invited to join, with the matter offered for import into their own workspace.
Share a brief or handover as a secure, expiring link
Referral credits in `packages/billing` (a free month for both sides) and abuse limits.
Funnel metrics: invites sent, accepted and activated.
A shared brief link works for a non-user, expires, and converts to a sign-up with the referral credited. [type:e2e]
No matter data is visible beyond the shared item, and links can be revoked. [type:integration]
